name: hero-band
purpose: The opening band of a marketing page: the page `h1` with its overline, accent phrase, sentence and up to two actions, full width above the page column, with an optional client strip on the floor. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'hero-band', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `hero`, `hero-title`, `button` and `illustration`. `kind` picks the layout only: `centered` fills a screen over a dot field with the copy centered, `title-band` is a padded band with the copy centered, `pixel-floor` sets the copy at the start over an animated pixel floor, and `copy-beside-art` sets an illustration beside the copy; every layout takes the same copy, actions and client strip.
useWhen: To open a home, solution, product, listing or contact page with its headline and main actions.
avoidWhen: For a hero followed by a grid of arguments → use `hero-with-opening`.
For a hero with a topology scene under the copy → use `hero-copy-on-top-art`.
For a band inside the page column → use `section-module` or a sibling section.
related: hero` — the band primitive every layout is rendered with.
hero-title` — the headline block rendered inside it.
bestPractices: Use `title-band` with `size="large"` for a product page and `size="medium"` for a page whose bands start right under the headline.
Give `illustration` and `illustrationAriaLabel` only to the `copy-beside-art` layout; the other layouts ignore them.
Set `headerOffset` to the height of the site header so a band that fills a screen fills exactly the first screen with it.

props.name: kind
props.doc: Layout of the band: `centered` fills a screen over a dot field, `title-band` is a padded band, `pixel-floor` sets the copy over an animated pixel floor, `copy-beside-art` sets an illustration beside the copy.

props.name: size
props.doc: Vertical rhythm of the band; `large` is the opening a product page leads with.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Opening words of the headline, painted in the brand accent; reads as one sentence with `title`.

props.name: title
props.doc: Page headline, rendered as the page `h1`; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: First button under the headline; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Shown only with a label and a link.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: Second, outlined button beside the first; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Shown only with a label and a link.

props.name: carouselMarks
props.doc: Registry names of the client marks on the band floor, in order; the strip renders only when it has marks.

props.name: illustration
props.doc: Registry name of the illustration set beside the copy in the `copy-beside-art` layout.

props.name: headerOffset
props.doc: Height of the site header above the band, taken out of a band that fills a screen; any CSS length.

<script setup>
  import HeroBand from '@aziontech/webkit/hero-band'
</script>

<template>
  <HeroBand
    kind="title-band"
    size="large"
    eyebrow="Cache"
    title="Deliver content fast, worldwide"
    description="Serve cached content close to users. Cut origin load and keep applications fast during traffic spikes."
    :primary-action="{ label: 'Start for free', href: 'https://console.azion.com/signup/' }"
    :secondary-action="{
      label: 'Docs',
      href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/',
      trailing: true
    }"
  />
</template>
